decisions.reason: The margin analysis still has its own page and runs on the firm's maintained market data, so keeping the option open costs little while its value for utilities is still emerging.
The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core tariff database, costs little to maintain, and shows no sign that its value will fail to materialize.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is a cheap extension of the established data platform and remains a reasonable option on the central platform.
This multi-model line is only mentioned on the website and overlaps with C, so consolidation is plausible, but it is still not clearly worthless and keeping it costs little.
The area definition tool underpins the other location-based products, which raises the value of those options at low cost.
